Context: DESIGN.md §3 defines B2/B3; §11 notes Linux CPU peak RSS was 2.9GB (above 2.5GB target) and timings were contended/unquotable. Relevant code: src/cyvd/engine_applio/engine.py (has _MPS_MARKERS CPU-fallback logic), src/cyvd/tts_kokoro/tts.py, src/cyvd/server/pipeline.py. Workspace /Users/sachinkoli/github/clone-your-voice, branch main. Work in /tmp/cyv-b23-<random>, do not modify repo files, never commit/push.
